title: Using ChatGPT in HCI Research—A Trioethnography
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative study using trioethnography to explore the lived experiences of researchers using ChatGPT in HCI. While it discusses ethical provocations such as accountability, bias (particularly from a Global South perspective), and 'responsible AI thinking,' it focuses on researcher sentiment and user experience rather than providing a formal evaluation or benchmark of moral, ethical, or religious frameworks.
